page.overview:
Who is Lance Reddick?

He played Cedric Daniels in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Wire The Wire] (2002–2008), [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fringe_characters#Phillip_Broyles Phillip Broyles] in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fringe_(TV_series) Fringe] (2008–2013), Chief Irvin Irving in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bosch_(TV_series) Bosch] (2014–2020), [https://johnwick.fandom.com/wiki/Charon Charon] in the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/John_Wick John Wick] franchise (2014–2023) and General Caulfield in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/White_House_Down White House Down] (2013). He also voiced Zavala in the Destiny franchise, Agent Clappers in Paradise PD, and Thordak in The Legend of Vox Machina.

Reddick tragically died from heart disease on March 17, 2023, aged 60, at his home in Studio City, Los Angeles. Category:Cast Category:Voice actors Category:A to Z Category:Deceased
